newsitem.title: USA: Vons up/Safeway down on deal.
newsitem.headline: Vons up/Safeway down on deal.

text.p: Vons Cos Inc's shares rose and Safeway Inc shares eased on news the two companies agreed to a merger, valued at $1.5 billion, that analysts expect will mprove earnings and margins.

"Our whole feeling is its very positive. It gives Safeway an opportunitity to grow. Vons can be accretive to Safeway by 1998 and possibly 1997. We believe Safeway can take Vons margins up to speed. Its goal is to bring Vons margins from around 6.5 percent to eight percent EBITDA," said one analyst.
Vons rose 3-3/8 to 52-1/8, while Safeway fell 3/4 to 37-5/8.
Safeway earlier said Vons had accepted a revised offer to buy the Vons shares it does not own by issuing 1.425 shares for each Vons sahre it does not own, up from 1.34 shares offered on October 30.
While the exchange ratio was increased, the dollar value decreased from the proposal in October, in which Safeway would have paid about $56.45 for each Vons share or $1.65 billion.

Based on Friday's closing price of about 38-3/8, Safeway would pay about $54.69 a share for the 28.56 million shares it does not own. Also, Safeway will buy 15 million shares of Safeway stock from Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co partnerships.
It said the the price of its repuchase would be determined later, but would not be less than $38.375 per share.
Analysts said that company officials on a conference call said they might expand its repurchasing program.
Analysts said they were forecasting Safeway to earn about $2.30 a share for 1997 versus an estimated $1.87 a share for 1996.
Analysts said they are forecasting Safeway to earn about $0.58 a share in the fourth quarter versus $0.47 a share in the year-ago quarter.
They said they were forecasting Safeway to earn $2.70 a share in 1998, excluding the Vons acquisition.

"Based on the first proposal, we forecast the deal to be $0.15 a share accretive; but with today's proposal and share buyback, it should be $0.20 to $0.25 a share accretive, so we could raise 1998 estimates to $2.90 to $2.95 a share," said one analyst.
